title: Content Security Policy as a second line of defence

videos.script: Lesson 4 escaped every value the portal writes into a page. That is the first line, and it has to hold everywhere. {{first}} One day, in one template, somebody will forget. {{forget}} Content Security Policy is the second line. It is one response header, and it tells the browser which scripts this page may run. {{header}} Scripts from the portal's own files run. A script that turns up inside the page does not, whoever put it there. {{inline}} The catch is that the portal's own inline scripts stop too. So the policy goes out in report-only mode first, the reports say what would break, and the scripts move into files. {{report}} Today you watch a real browser report, then obey. {{today}}
